A quadratic equation in the variable x with real coefficients has a root x=−9+2i. Given that the coefficient of x2 in the equation is 1, find the equation.

a
x2+9x+79=0
b
x2+18x+79=0
c
x2−9x+79=0
d
x2+18x+83=0
e
x2−18x+83=0
